requests.title: AI-assisted clothing design: voice and hands-on design, costing, manufacturing, store and marketing
requests.ask: AI agent assisted, software assisted clothing design, where the software handles basically everything including marketing, distribution, manufacturing and manufacturer deals. The designer works in a web browser (and later VR) by voice and by pointing and clicking: describe the garment, get a rendering, give spoken or manual feedback, compare versions. Fabric choices come from what manufacturers offer, with prices, so the designer knows what each shirt costs. From an interview with a designer planning a unisex line with raised, '3D' prints of classical and devotional paintings, sold in Europe and the US, possibly with other brands on the same site for a commission.
requests.next: v0 is live: voice/typed and drag design of tees, sweatshirts and hoodies, three alternatives, costing from a supplier sheet, tech pack, quote request and launch kit. Unproven: whether the designer gets a real garment quoted with it. Next: their artwork and a real quote through it, then turning an uploaded painting into a printable colour separation with a raised outline, then a 3D/VR preview (ROADMAP.md).
